meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Agent source and JSON persistence are unchanged; reviewed their existing scoped catches and X-Agent-Trace against the shared backend skill addition. Generic uncaught failures can correlate a valid existing agent trace but cannot alter completed turns, reviews, customer outcomes or authorize replay. Existing 31-case and concurrency acceptance remain distinct from semantic accuracy.

auth.review_note: AuthService/AdminController role checks and CSRF/redirect implementations are unchanged; reviewed session startup ordering and existing cookies under the response boundary. It neither authorizes users nor clears auth cookies; guest denial and normal signed-in admin paths pass. CLI auth fixtures remain isolated, and no user password or login identity is changed.

commerce.review_note: No order/payment/catalogue source changed. Reviewed existing verified-order/idempotency contracts and shared backend guidance; the generic handler explicitly cannot infer rollback or advise repeating a charge. Normal product/feed/API reads and intentional service failures remain covered; no production purchase or business-data write used as a test.

content.review_note: Verified article cards keep a single accessible link to each post and category navigation remains present on mobile.

foundation.review_note: Verified the canonical owner subject, scoped acknowledgement and PHP persistence boundary.

google-tags.review_note: Verified the frontend skill motion additions leave the public and owner tag rendering guidance intact.

http-errors.review_note: Compared bootstrap/session initialization, old global handler, BaseController redirects/JSON/view output and actual API catches with RequestFailureService. Native response buffer and safe500 replace only unhandled failures; 88 loopback HTTP assertions preserve normal HTML/JSON/XML/binary/204/redirect/explicit503. Docs state pre-bootstrap/OOM/streaming limits and uncertainty of earlier side effects; no raw message/admin stack or database accusation.

interface.review_note: Verified homepage layers, focus and pointer inputs, snapshot evidence and the current Nebo reference.

mail.review_note: Verified draft restoration omits mail preferences and save acknowledgement follows the existing newsletter decision.

media.review_note: Reviewed the revised admin guidance with the existing Media Library keyboard and focus requirements.

operator-help.review_note: Verified the mobile checkout shortcut, route and total behavior against the existing customer and operator guidance.

sales-channels.review_note: Reviewed service/XML/CLI/UI against ProductService offer and visibility behavior plus current primary Google product-source and invited-creator docs. Verified explicit identifiers only, valid URL/image checks, safe XML, unknown external approval and no credential/account actions. Public browser samples match real prices/images; local missing media is not labelled a production defect.

workflow.review_note: Verified the editorial handoff keyboard-focus policy and documentation against the project review workflow.
